column3: Close to the Hebrew; “wooden images” renders “Asherim,” the cult poles of Asherah.
Close to the Hebrew; “a special treasure” renders “segullah,” a treasured possession.
Close to the Hebrew; “the hornet” is an uncertain word, which some take as “panic” or “plague.”
Close to the Hebrew; “doomed to destruction” and “an accursed thing” render “herem,” what is devoted to destruction.
